summary: Salt Lake City Remodels (slcremodels.com) is an Established contractor site with excellent reputation (4.8/46 reviews) and strong SEO/accessibility foundations, but mobile performance is Poor at 47/100 with 10.4s LCP. Evidence supports prioritized fixes for speed, broken-link maintenance, and homepage clarity before adding conversion features. Score 66 suggests Review — solid opportunity if owner wants faster mobile experience and clearer positioning.

topOpportunities.title: Fix poor mobile performance and LCP
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse mobile performance: 47/100; largest contentful paint: 10.4s (10356ms) — deterministic mainIssue: Mobile performance
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Slow 10.4s LCP and 11.6s Time to Interactive on mobile can make portfolio browsing feel sluggish, even though SEO and best practices are already 100/100.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Prioritize Squarespace-specific speed improvements: compress/resize hero images, reduce unused JavaScript (Est savings of 376 KiB) and unused CSS (89 KiB), and defer render-blocking requests.

topOpportunities.title: Repair 1 broken internal link
topOpportunities.evidence: Broken internal links: 1 of 5 checked — url: https://www.slcremodels.com/search status: 403
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: One broken link out of a small 5-link set is proportionally large and creates a dead end during site maintenance checks.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix or remove the broken /search link and re-check all 5 internal links; ensure navigation does not point to the 403 search page.

topOpportunities.title: Clarify homepage heading hierarchy
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage H1 count: 2 — finding: The homepage does not use one clear primary heading.
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Two competing H1s dilutes the primary message for visitors and search clarity, despite existing word count of 1064 on homepage.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Consolidate to one clear H1 that states service + location (e.g., Kitchen & Bath Remodels in Salt Lake City) and demote secondary heading to H2; fix heading-order issue flagged by Lighthouse.

topOpportunities.title: Strengthen homepage title and meta description
topOpportunities.evidence: Meta description length: 67 characters — description: "At SLC Remodels it is our goals to make your dreams become reality!"
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Current 67-character description is too brief to explain the offer clearly in search results, even though SEO score is 100/100.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Rewrite title and meta description to be specific, service-led, and ~150 characters with location and offer (e.g., services, specialties). Keep Page title: Salt Lake City Remodels but expand it.
